core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Muaz corresponds to the Arabic form معز (Arabic root ع ز ز (ʿ-z-z); مُعِزّ (Muʿizz)). Its core sense is one who honours, giver of honour. Muaz is recorded here as Arabic مُعِزّ (Muʿizz) 'one who honours, giver of honour', from the root ع ز ز (ʿ-z-z). The source gloss 'Helper, Assistant, Companion' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is male.
